design_principle: Official Samsung Business facts are separated from BD interpretation metadata.

official.name: SmartThings Pro
official.summary: Integrated B2B IoT solution for remote management, automation, energy analysis and connected device/building operation.

must_know_candidates: Is building/device control scope already specified?
Who owns the HVAC/IoT/energy-management specification?
Is the relevant package owner-direct or included in EPC/MEP scope?
Is there an incumbent BMS/IoT platform?

official.name: b.IoT
official.summary: Building/factory-oriented integrated operation solution for major facilities and systems, including central HVAC use cases.

must_know_candidates: Who controls the BMS/HVAC specification?
Has the central HVAC/BMS package already been awarded?
Which BMS or control platform is incumbent?
Is energy optimization part of the project KPI/specification?

official.name: System Air Conditioner / Central HVAC
official.summary: Samsung Business HVAC portfolio relevant to commercial and facility cooling/heating environments.

must_know_candidates: Has HVAC specification been frozen?
Who owns HVAC design/specification approval?
Has the HVAC package been tendered or awarded?
Is procurement owner-direct, EPC-led, or MEP-led?

official.name: Samsung Knox + Galaxy Mobile/Tablet
official.summary: Samsung Knox provides enterprise device security, configuration and management capabilities for Samsung mobile devices.

must_know_candidates: What field-device use cases are in scope?
Who owns enterprise mobility/security policy?
Is an MDM/EMM incumbent already selected?
What device deployment volume and timing are planned?

official.name: Samsung Signage + VXT CMS
official.summary: Business display portfolio with VXT content creation and management capabilities.

must_know_candidates: Which spaces require business displays?
Who owns display/content-management scope?
Has the AV/signage package been awarded?
Is centralized content/device management required?

official.name: Business PC / Monitor
official.summary: Samsung Business PC and monitor portfolio for enterprise workplace environments.

must_know_candidates: What endpoint/device scope is included in the project?
Who owns workplace IT procurement?
Is a standard device vendor already selected?
What is the rollout volume and schedule?

agent_usage_rules.purpose: Use portfolio knowledge to judge DX addressability and generate sales-relevant must-know information; do not treat it as a product recommendation catalog.
agent_usage_rules.must_know_rule: Keep a question only when its answer can change DX sales scope, target actor, buying route, workstream, or NOW/MONITOR decision.
agent_usage_rules.capability_rule: A capability may be shown only when linked to research evidence plus at least one matching BD metadata field.
agent_usage_rules.confidence_rule: BD metadata is an internal hypothesis framework, not an official Samsung claim. Research evidence must determine project-specific applicability.
